reasoning_content:
The `docker` is a podman-remote shim connecting via SSH to a podman machine (host). The connection dropped. This may be an environmental limitation now. Let me try restarting the connection or check docker context.

Actually `container=podman` env, and /usr/bin/docker is a podman wrapper that connects over SSH to remote podman socket. The remote host forcibly closed the connection. Let me try again, maybe the podman machine restarts.

action.command: docker context ls 2>&1 | head; echo "---"; cat /usr/bin/docker 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "--- sockets ---"; ls -la /var/run/docker.sock; echo "--- try curl on docker sock ---"; timeout 5 curl -s --unix-socket /var/run/docker.sock http://localhost/_ping 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"
